mainEntity.name: Does Stellar manage large high-rise associations in Streeterville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. High-rise condominium management is a core Stellar practice: building staff coordination, elevator and mechanical contracts, facade and life-safety compliance, and reserve planning for major systems — with 24/7 live emergency response behind it.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle towers shared with hotels or commercial space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many Streeterville buildings operate under reciprocal easement or shared-facilities agreements with hotel, retail, or parking components. We administer those cost allocations, audit shared expenses, and represent the association's interests in operator meetings.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Streeterville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Streeterville, Chicago (ZIP 60611), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Streeterville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for condominiums, high-rises, HOAs in Streeterville. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Streeterville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Streeterville association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Streeterville association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Streeterville board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Streeterville can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.
